LeaveRecord.title: LeaveRecord
LeaveRecord.description: A record of leave taken, duty worked, or leave credit for a Tamil Nadu Government Medical Officer.

userId.description: The authenticated user UID owning this leave record.

leaveType.description: Category of Tamil Nadu Government leave or duty.

dateIso.description: Date of leave or duty in YYYY-MM-DD format.

year.description: Calendar year of the leave record (e.g., 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025, 2026).

pairedDateIso.description: For COL, the In-Lieu-Of duty date; for PL, the GH Worked date; or empty string.

notes.description: Additional remarks, highlight status (e.g., Unpaired / Pending Credit, Hospital Duty, Conference).

highlightStatus.description: Visual badge matching spreadsheet color coding.

isHalfDay.description: Whether this is a half-day Casual Leave.

LeaveEntry.title: LeaveEntry
LeaveEntry.description: Represents a user leave entry with leaveType, startDate, endDate, status, and optional paired GH/duty date.

userId.description: The authenticated user UID owning this leave entry.

leaveType.description: Category of Tamil Nadu Government leave or duty.

startDate.description: Start date of the leave spell in YYYY-MM-DD format.

endDate.description: End date of the leave spell in YYYY-MM-DD format.

totalDays.description: Total number of leave days in the spell (supports 0.5 for half-day CL).

status.description: Current approval or audit pairing status of the leave entry.

year.description: Calendar year of the leave entry.

pairedDutyDate.description: Optional paired GH Worked or In-Lieu duty date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

reason.description: Remarks or reason for the leave entry.

isHalfDay.description: Whether this leave entry is a half-day Casual Leave.

/users/{userId}/leave_records/{recordId}.description: User-isolated Tamil Nadu Government leave and credit records.

/users/{userId}/leave_entries/{entryId}.description: User-isolated multi-day or single-day LeaveEntry records with start/end dates and status.
